result.summary: The page renders mostly well, but the bottom navigation bar is visually broken: a stray dark horizontal bar overlaps the search icon and some nav icons appear clipped at the screen edge.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a stray dark horizontal bar/line spans across the middle of the bar, overlapping and obscuring the search icon and the receipt/bookmark icon. Additionally, these two middle icons appear partially clipped at the bottom edge of the viewport, while the home and profile icons render fully.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray horizontal bar element (or ensure it renders behind/above the nav correctly) and ensure all bottom navigation icons are vertically centered and fully rendered within the navigation bar's bounds.
